import mysql.connector
import requests

def sync_crm_to_reporting():
    # Connect to CRM API
    crm_response = requests.get('https://crm.internal/api/customers', 
                                headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer FAKE_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'})
    customers = crm_response.json()
    
    # Connect to reporting database
    conn = mysql.connector.connect(
        host='reporting-db.internal',
        user='sync_user',
        password='SyncPass2024!',
        database='reporting'
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Insert customer records
    for customer in customers:
        name = customer.get('name')
        email = customer.get('email')
        phone = customer.get('phone')
        
        query = f"INSERT INTO report_users (name, email, phone) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{phone}')"
        cursor.execute(query)
    
    conn.commit()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    print(f"Synced {len(customers)} records successfully")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_crm_to_reporting()
